title: Buddha's teaching of four more inhabited Earth-like planets

tellings.quote: As the great Buddha wrote 2,600 years ago, in our solar system, there are four more planets similar to planet Earth where practically the same exact people live

plain: The Buddha taught 2,600 years ago that our solar system holds four more planets like Earth, where 'practically the same exact people live', says Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former leader of a republic within Russia who tells Michels he was himself taken by aliens. He presents it as the Buddha's own teaching. If it were so, it would mean an ancient religious teacher had spoken of human life on other worlds.
